notes.title: Tiny Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/7c91e3191707ad4357a972b767195e11aa84cd6e.png

Hello wonderful people!

As announced earlier this month, the open beta is now available for all of you, who own the game.

A little recap on what this beta is:
we are upgrading the game engine to Godot 4 which will allow us to add more content features while also improving the overall stability and performance of the game.

The primary reason why we upgrade this 4 year old game at all is the absolute mess that the code base grew into over the years which makes adding new content and features a real struggle. 
The biggest features that were limited by the current game engine is by far the support for animations and crossplatform support. 

With the new game engine we can finally add animations and also offer Steam Cloud saves to share your progress and saves across your devices, including a native Linux version and SteamDeck support.

The current beta stage has many of the existing features already working but some parts are still WIP, so here is a little overview of things to try in this beta:

working features

 play the base game content, with choices and path branching
 save/load your game progress
 unlock achievements
 change settings from the main menu
 use the Roadmap to replay parts of the game (WIP but mostly works)
 English translation


WIP

 skip/rollback dialogue
 Gallery
 change settings during gameplay
 input remapping (controller support)
 translation support (German, Brasilian Portuguese)
 Steam Workshop integration (for more translations)
 DLC support (works on the free Halloween2020 DLC already)


The above lists are just the main features so please expect some things to still behave a bit... unexpected.

tl;dr
Cool stuff, but how can you play the beta?!

You can activate the open beta with these 3 easy steps:
[olist]
 go into the Midnight Ride properties
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/40e111644824e524b418474ed93ad260997dec5e.jpg

 select the Betas menu
 from this dropdown, select the "open_beta" (if you don't see this option, restart your Steam)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/5fc81f505c0d4ad67db06eba80743a71fd49ddc5.jpg

 close the properties menu and update your game
 enjoy
[/olist]

When all is set and done we would really appreciate feedback about this beta over here in the forums
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1210110/discussions/3/

notes.title: Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/47cc704c45aaf14f30a4c1df258c0445352eae38.jpg

Hello wonderful people!


It's been a while since our last public post about the upcoming final DLC for Midnight Ride... 
and yeah... about that:

While Nidma and Celtic are busy finalizing and polishing the content for the "Mad Scientist" DLC, I took on the task of porting the game to a new game engine. The limitations of the current game engine (GameMaker Studio) are the main reason why our game has no animations for example. 

Primarily for that reason and because it was a good opportunity to implement a few other needed changes like cloud saves for device compatibility (Steam Deck etc) I decided to rebuild the game from scratch in Godot 4.

The end result of this rebuild will not look too much different to the current version apart from the benefits of running on a more modern and capable game engine which will allow us to add some much requested additional content.

In the near future there will be a playable test version for owners of the game on the beta channel here on Steam and I hope to get some feedback from all of you awesome people.

So stay tuned for more information very soon!

notes.title: Update on the Release Date of the next DLC
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/94b7938aa052bf98ae8471128d25521dd2bd21b8.jpg

Hey guys, hope you're doing awesome! We've got some news about the game update we've all been hyped for, and we wanted to fill you in.

The update we were aiming to drop by the end of the year is hitting a speed bump. As most of you know we're a small team of 3 people, and this year was rough on us and it impacted our capacity to create.

Ever since we've started this project we kept our releases yearly, but two of us had main job related problems, taking a chunck of our time and energy. Most of it is resolved already, but it delayed us a lot.

We know it's a bummer to wait a bit longer, and we're sorry for any letdown. But trust us, we wouldn't be doing that if it was not necessary, we want to have a proper release, no rushed content or a half-baked update.

The new release should happen in the first half of 2024, but as always we'll keep you posted. Thanks for being part of this awesome community and for your patience.

If you've got any burning questions or just want to chat, hit up the comments below.

Cheers

notes.title: News and Availability Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/03910f7962fb88314184d0f954df663ef12f06a9.png

Hello guys, once again we come with news! First of all we'd like to thank you all for the support, with the release of the Season Pass and of our first DLC - Galactic Detour, we have been receiving outpouring support from you and we are extremely happy and thankful for that.

These last few weeks we have been working on some things, the first of them is spreading our presence more over the internet, we know some countries can't buy Midnight Ride and the DLCs directly on Steam, so we now have a new homepage that contains all of our links, including to other marketplaces where you can grab keys and activate here. You can access it here:

http://hornynpc.games/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/b453d41c58e7fa89bec5237e529b4c945ec8e3c9.jpg


We'd also like to thank the community for embracing our mod support, we already have our first translation on the Workshop, it's a Russian translation made by the modder Groove, so we thank them for that and hope that we'll see even more languages going forward!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2663564006

And last but not least, just a reminder that the DLC - Galactic Detour is already out and released! There are still two more that are coming and will be included in the Season Pass when they arrive, so stay tuned and grab your copy if you didn't already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1353360
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356050

As always we'll keep you all informed of our development, thanks for being with us in this Midnight Ride!

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/8e273f9421059ba72fc7069a554e0c85dce7558d.jpg

Progress on the new DLC is going well!

As mentioned in a previous news post, the DLC will contain 4 new story paths to explore. Both images shown here are from different story lines but don't worry, it won't all be female characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/697dfbc945403d9c01cad3394d398f7490a827f2.jpg


Planned Expansions
The new DLC will become available as part of a Season Pass and as a standalone purchase. The Season Pass will include 3 DLCs and will give you a discount on the individual prices of the DLCs. 

However pricing has not yet been decided but the DLCs will cost less than the base game of course.


More Updates

We decided to expand our portfolio due to popular demand!
The game will become available as macOS and Linux builds in the near future and an Android build for tablets could also be an option if demand keeps up like this.
